title: Study of BHV-1400 in IgA Nephropathy
official: An Open-Label Biomarker Study of BHV-1400 in IgA Nephropathy
summary: The purpose of this study is to determine if BHV-1400 is a safe and tolerable treatment in participants with IgA Nephropathy (IgAN).
criteria:
Key Inclusion Criteria:

1\. Participants must have biopsy-confirmed IgA Nephropathy

Key Exclusion Criteria:

1. Any secondary IgAN
2. Any cause of chronic kidney disease not diagnosed as IgAN or due to non-IgAN cause
